title: Payments API CrashLoop
impact: Requests intermittently failed while the replacement Pod restarted.

observations.finding: The api container restarted five times.

hypotheses.statement: The process exceeded its memory limit.
evidence: Previous logs ended with an OOM message.

tests.result: The previous process reported an OOM condition.

conclusion: The observed restart was caused by an OOM condition.

recommendedChanges.change: Review the memory request and limit after profiling.
recommendedChanges.expectedImpact: Reduce OOM restarts without masking an application leak.

validation: Observe restart count and memory behavior after an approved change.

sources.label: Kubernetes observation
sources.reference: pod-health and previous logs in staging/payments
